Body.Content:
Sellers and service reps lose time piecing together a customer picture from tabs, records, and reports, and still miss the signals that matter. Account and Contact 360 delivers one AI-powered view of every account and contact, with relationship, engagement, and opportunity insights and recommended next steps. It works wherever people work: in Dynamics 365 Sales and Customer Service, and in Microsoft 365 through the Sales and Service agents and Cowork. Admins tailor insights to their own data and terminology, with no custom code.

GA date: January CY2027

Preview date: November CY2026
